goal: Prevent false-positive live/package actionability when HTTP 200 or a requisition token survives on a dead, generic, or contentless page by requiring a positive semantic quorum before Bora-facing package work.
acceptance_conditions: HTTP status 200 alone never establishes current actionability
a surviving requisition token/string alone never establishes current actionability
positive matching role/title identity, matching requisition identity, substantive current JD content, and current application route/instructions are all required together
explicit dead/error-page markers force fail-closed even if HTTP 200 and requisition text are present
the Point32Health R9102 HTTP-200 dead-page failure is captured as the reproduced defect
no schema/runtime/Qualification Truth/Candidate Truth/Match Truth/immigration/recency-window changes
stop_conditions: implementation requires runtime/browser automation or schema changes
implementation weakens existing Section 135 or 141 actionability requirements
implementation turns transport success or raw token presence into positive actionability evidence
implementation changes resume content/layout doctrine or recency policy
